calls.text: {"meetingId": "294", "tickets": [{"templateId": null, "title": "Prepare transfer instructions for charitable share donation", "text": "Prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of Nora Nettlewhisk's long-held Copper Firefly Utilities shares to her donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable, using the appreciated shares to manage capital gains.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-08-02", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed August 2 follow-up is to prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of Copper Firefly Utilities shares to Nora’s donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable."}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Obtain charitable status letter for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust", "text": "Obtain a current charitable status letter or receipt-language sample for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust to support Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk's charitable giving.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-08-09", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Needed by August 9 are a current charitable status letter or receipt-language sample for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust"}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Resolve Marzipan Meadow Arts School EIN payee mismatch", "text": "Resolve the EIN payee mismatch between Marzipan Meadow Arts School and its foundation so Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk's charitable gift can be processed.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-08-05", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "needed by August 5 is resolution of the Marzipan Meadow Arts School/Foundation EIN payee mismatch."}]}
